status: Acceptance registered before implementation evaluation. No CPU or sound qualification is implied.
evidence_kind: Algebraic/stochastic continuation of the existing declared Gaussian software sources, not hardware measurements.

sources.panel: CS-80 service manual SUB29:0.047uF/100k coupling,1M/4.7k stage,10uF/10k coupling,10M/10k stage. Shared C1/C2 to NO1/NO2 fan-out is source-derived.3MHz op-amp GBW, Gaussian unclipped drive and software level calibration are existing declared inferences; alternatives remain in src/reference/NoiseSpectrum.h and docs/workstreams/ws2-engine.md.
sources.hiss: Existing declared output-bus inference: independent left/right Gaussian sources with15/5Hz and160/80Hz shelves, representing a100Hz flicker corner.50/200Hz alternatives and absence of a measured hardware floor remain documented.
sources.scheduler: New numerical realization of those declared sources. Sampling their conditional state after unobserved intervals preserves the ideal Gaussian law within stated floating-point limits; deterministic PRNG sequences intentionally change after dormancy.

ownership.panel_dormant_iff: Both current rankSettings[0].noise and rankSettings[1].noise have zero IEEE754 magnitude bits. Negative zero is allowed; subnormals, nonzero, infinity and NaN must keep the original full-rate path. Do not use voice count, VCA state, output volume, mute or a threshold.
ownership.panel_consumers: Engine::tickGlobals obtains the shared panelNoise; its only downstream use is Engine::tickRanks x += panelNoise*rs.noise*0.8f. With both rank gains exactly zero there is no connected rank/filter consumer, including future charge.
ownership.hiss_dormant_iff: Current global.analogNoise has zero IEEE754 magnitude bits. Any nonzero/subnormal/nonfinite value keeps full rate.
ownership.hiss_consumers: Engine::mixBus adds hissL/R only through global.analogNoise*0.0008f, before BBD/output circuits. These gains must be exactly zero to suppress the source.
unchanged_rng_owners: Engine audioRng per-rank legacy draws and both hiss draws are still consumed in their original order.
OriginalSubOscillator NO3 retains its existing separate RNG; this work does not claim to complete the physical SUB29 fan-out into that model.
The per-voice idle replay RNG remains separate and unchanged.
ownership.policy: Use only in existing source-model branches. Legacy never calls the new dormant path. This is circuit-model scheduling, with no new modern control or PURE exception.

law.existing_step: For each first-order section, y=b0*x+b1*x_previous+a1*y_previous. Cascade coefficients and Gaussian variance N0*fs/2 are unchanged.
law.reduced_state: Previous cascade input plus each section output:5 dimensions for the4-section panel chain,3 for the2-section hiss chain. Section input memories are reconstructed from the preceding section output. The independent oracle retains all2*section_count input/output memories.
law.conditional_transition: x[n+N]=A^N*x[n]+eta_N; E[eta_N]=0; Q_N=sum(k=0..N-1) A^k*B*B^T*(A^k)^T, with sigma absorbed in B.
law.precomputation: Prepare fixed A^N and a covariance factor for everyN=1..32. A stable QR factorization of the innovation columns is permitted; no pole fitting, diagonal covariance shortcut or added noise is permitted.
law.cadence: Advance each dormant source at absolute multiples of32 source samples since reset/prepare, independently of render block boundaries. Preserve the exact number of elapsed samples, complete any partial interval before the first active sample, and then use the original per-sample section/Gaussian path.
law.reset_prepare_copy: Reset and prepare clear pending samples and absolute counters using the original seed/state reset semantics. Plain copies preserve every section state, Gaussian spare/RNG state, pending sample count, absolute counter and prepared transition. A rate change retains the original prepare/reset behavior.
law.zero_output: Dormant source output is declared+0. The existing per-rank and hiss multiply/add expressions remain in place, including IEEE signs from a negative-zero gain. Adding a signed zero leaves a finite nonzero accumulator unchanged; the sign of an exactly-zero accumulator may differ from the old unobserved random sample. Exercise both gain zero signs and zero/nonzero mix histories; report this as part of the intentional V2 realization change, never as whole-engine byte identity after dormancy. No output fade, capacitor reset, tail cutoff, gain change or altered active per-sample source law is allowed.

truth.full_section_oracle: tests/DormantNoiseTruth.h: independently clock every original section memory in long double for each basis vector and each Gaussian innovation; it must not call production reduced-state or factorization helpers.
truth.transition_metric: Maximum absolute entry error of A^N, scaled by max(1, absolute oracle entry). Also compare conditional means from zero and the fixed nonzero state vector.
truth.covariance_metric: For every element of F*F^T, absolute difference from independently accumulated Q_N divided by sqrt(Q_ii*Q_jj). A zero oracle variance requires absolute error<=2e-12; N=0 must be exact identity/zero innovation.
truth.psd_requirement: F*F^T must be finite and positive semidefinite within2e-12 times its trace. No regularization/jitter or discarded small eigenmode is permitted.
truth.composition: Independently compose registered N<=32 transitions/covariances and compare with the frozen full-section law. Large intervals may use binary composition; they are not sampled by a million-step Monte Carlo.
truth.rank_retention: Each fixed section has a pole/zero mismatch, all source poles are distinct, and no section zero cancels another section pole. Thus the N-step innovation rank is min(N,state_dimension). Canonicalize the lower factor to positive diagonal by consistent QR row/sign flips. Require each diagonal through the stated rank strictly positive and finite; unused factor columns are exactly zero. Inspect the implementation for the absence of magnitude thresholds, covariance regularization, diagonal jitter, eigenmode truncation or fallback-to-zero. This verifies retained nonzero modes; it does not claim relative accuracy of arbitrarily tiny covariance eigenvalues beyond the stated entrywise covariance criterion.
truth.rank_mutation: After factorization, zero the smallest nonzero factor column. The rank-retention assertion must reject that actual-source mutation even when its entrywise covariance error is below2e-12.

conditional_moments.seed_rule: One continuous frozen Gaussian stream per case. Seed is fixed before evaluation as mix32(0x4e4f4953u ^ rate_index*0x9e3779b9u ^ interval_index*0x85ebca6bu ^ initial_index*0xc2b2ae35u ^ chain_index*0x27d4eb2du); mix32 applies x^=x>>16; x*=0x7feb352du; x^=x>>15; x*=0x846ca68bu; x^=x>>16, with32-bit wrap. Never choose seeds from observed results.
conditional_moments.method: Accumulate deviations from the independent conditional mean in long double. Compare empirical mean/standard deviation and the full empirically centered covariance. Normalize each covariance error by sqrt(Q_ii*Q_jj), retaining cross-covariances.
conditional_moments.rationale: At262144 independent Gaussian realizations,0.01sigma is5.12 standard errors of the mean;0.015 on a variance is5.43 standard errors. This is a preregistered finite-sample check, not a replacement for the2e-12 algebraic covariance gate.
conditional_moments.channel_rule: Separate inherited left/right seeds and Gaussian states. Test both dormant and post-wake streams; never share an innovation vector.
conditional_moments.initialization: Each Monte Carlo realization starts from exactly the same declared x0 and zero elapsed/pending samples. Only the one prescribed Gaussian RNG/spare sequence continues across realizations. Never use one long evolving section-state trajectory as a conditional ensemble.

active_and_wake.active_byte_identity: At every registered rate, compare65536 consecutive panel and stereo hiss samples with the independent frozen active source, including reset/prepare. A source that has never been dormant must be byte-identical.
active_and_wake.schedules: Exercise every partial length0..31, exact32/64 boundaries, long gaps, back-to-back active/dormant transitions, reset while pending, rate change and copies while pending. Every first active sample must finish exactly the elapsed dormant interval before advancing the original one-sample path.
active_and_wake.partition_byte_identity: The new seeded law must render byte-identically for identical sample-position events under1-frame,256-frame and repeating17/1/63/511/4 partitions; verify component scheduling and Engine integration. A zero-frame control event advances no noise time.
active_and_wake.post_wake_psd: At each registered rate, advance floor(0.5*fs)+17 dormant samples, then record immediately from the first active sample using the existing NoiseTests.cpp17*FFT-length Welch procedure. No post-wake discard, fade, alternate seed, or relaxed band/statistical limits.
active_and_wake.engine_ownership: Render fixtures with only rankI noise, only rankII noise, both, hiss alone, and physical-tab/programmer noise sources. Any active consumer must retain its original source path. Include positive/negative zero and subnormal guard probes independent of floating-point denormal mode. Retain the original coherent panel fan-out and legacy independent-voice gates.
active_and_wake.signed_zero: Probe+0/-0 panel and hiss gains with both exact-zero and finite nonzero downstream histories. Keep the original multiply/add order. Active source samples remain byte-identical when no dormancy has occurred; exact-zero sign differences after dormant substitution belong to the explicitly re-pinned V2 law. Legacy arithmetic and its signed-zero behavior must remain byte-identical.

work.disabled_4096_samples: Exactly128 absolute32-sample updates per source. At most640 panel and384 per-channel hiss Gaussian next() calls, compared with4096 on each full-rate source. Source-call counters required by this assertion are temporary test instrumentation, not shipping telemetry.
work.partial: A wake may add at most min(pending_samples,state_dimension) Gaussian samples before the normal active sample; no unbounded loop or render-thread allocation.
work.preparation: Bounded fixed-size matrices only. No allocation on audio processing or ownership transitions; prepare cost is reported separately.
work.timing: Run the unchanged source-factory benchmark for a minimum of3 serial rounds before and after this isolated patch. Report held/moving/idle, p99 and deadline misses; the0.15-0.20 RTF /0.02 idle targets remain open unless measured.

mutations: count one batch as one elapsed sample
discard the smallest nonzero covariance-factor column
drop the partial interval on wake
reset cadence from render block boundaries
declare panel dormant when only one rank gain is zero
declare hiss dormant while analogNoise is nonzero
clear charged section states before wake
compatibility: Legacy default/tails and V1 numerics must remain byte-identical. This intentionally changes the circuit-engine seeded sequence after a dormant interval; use a separate audio commit, full-SHA V2 re-pin commit and strict compatibility gate. Do not represent these outputs as bit-identical to the old V2 after dormancy. Preserve all existing noise, cold/wake/phase, click and unrelated circuit gates without relaxation.
rate_scope: The original six ws2 rates retain indexes0..5;705600 and768000Hz are appended as indexes6..7 to cover HQ8 at88.2/96k host. Every new algebraic, conditional-moment, active-continuation and post-wake statistical gate covers all eight rates. Existing ws2 gates remain unchanged.
